meta.promptText: I want to buy a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast on Indian skin. Which one is best?

response.text:
If you want a sunscreen that leaves **no white cast on Indian skin**, I’d start with a lightweight, modern-filter sunscreen rather than a traditional mineral sunscreen. For Mumbai’s hot, humid weather, a formula that feels light and doesn't get greasy is a big plus.

My recommendation is to look for **SPF 50 with PA++++**, ideally with a fluid or gel texture. These are the options I’d shortlist based on current Indian skincare recommendations and available products. search_results.title: From French Skincare to Glossy Hair Treatments: 43 Beauty Items Worth Snagging on October Prime Day
search_results.description: Amazon’s October Prime Day 2026, held on October 6-7, offers a massive two-day beauty sale featuring deep discounts of up to 50% on top-rated items. This guide by Who What Wear highlights 43 standout deals across skincare, haircare, makeup, bodycare, fragrance, and wellness products. Featured discounts include editor-approved essentials like French pharmacy must-haves from Avène, K-beauty products such as Anua's moisturizing cream, and trending items like vitamin C serums, LED masks, and retinoid creams. Popular fragrance deals include scents loved by celebrities, while wellness deals range from melatonin-infused gummies to teeth-whitening kits. Haircare favorites like the Shark FlexStyle, Ouai leave-in conditioner, and Oribe wax stick are also significantly marked down. Makeup deals cover bestselling brow pencils, illuminating skin tints, and celebrity-favorite mascaras. To access these deals, shoppers must have an active Amazon Prime membership. Designed with guidance from industry professionals, this curated selection promises high-performing products suitable for various budgets and beauty routines.

search_results.title: I've switched my routine to Korean skincare - these 11 products left me GLOWING
search_results.description: A beauty expert from The Sun tested an array of Korean skincare products for over a month and reported remarkable improvements in skin hydration, clarity, and texture, leading to a glowing ‘glass skin’ effect. Korean skincare is praised for its innovative, science-backed formulations with a preventative approach to skin concerns. Eleven standout products were reviewed, including Medicube No Cast Just Glow Collagen Sunscreen (10/10 for sun protection and glow), Beauty of Joseon’s Eye Serum (9.5/10 for brightening and anti-aging), and the Medicube Night Wrapping Mask (9.5/10 for plump, hydrated skin). Other high-rated picks include SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule, Medicube Zero Pore Pads, and ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Serum, each tailored for hydration, repairing the skin barrier, and soothing inflammation. COSRX Snail Mucin, Dr Jart+ Moisturising Cream, and Mediheal Moisture Pads further impressed with their hydrating and rejuvenating effects. Products generally performed well across different skin types, including sensitive skin. The article highlights where to shop for K-beauty in the UK, emphasizing accessibility and value through retailer bundles and advent calendars. Overall, the author's switch to K-beauty resulted in improved skin health and radiance.
